records.title: Genes, Genomes and Heredity
records.header: BISSTS 231 Genes, Genomes and Heredity (5) SSc/NSc
records.text: BISSTS 231 Genes, Genomes and Heredity (5) SSc/NSc Explores basic concepts of heredity, including DNA structure and function, Mendel's rules of inheritance, and human genetic diseases. Goals include understanding current issues in the field, including genetic screening and testing, DNA fingerprinting and forensic analysis, the genetic basis of cancer, and genetically modified organisms. Offered: jointly with B BIO 231.

records.title: Science, Technology, and Society
records.header: BISSTS 307 Science, Technology, and Society (5) SSc
records.text: BISSTS 307 Science, Technology, and Society (5) SSc Presents concepts and theories used to investigate the creation, application, and governance of science and technology. Addresses the nature of scientific and technological knowledge, social construction of science and technology, democracy and science, and public understanding.

records.title: Race, Gender, Science, and Medicine
records.header: BISSTS 420 Race, Gender, Science, and Medicine (5) SSc, DIV
records.text: BISSTS 420 Race, Gender, Science, and Medicine (5) SSc, DIV Focuses on the interplay between science, technology, and medicine on the one hand, and race, gender, and sexuality on the other. Discusses how cultural ideas about race, gender, and sexuality influence knowledge and knowledge production as well as how scientific claims and technological developments influence cultural understandings of race, gender, and sexuality.
